// startCommand: Must be wrapped in `sh -c`. backend/Dockerfile declares ENTRYPOINT [dumb-init, --], so Railway appends the start command as ARGV to that entrypoint rather than running it through a shell. Unwrapped, the `&&` and everything after it are passed as arguments to migrate.mjs, which ignores them and exits 0 — the container then dies before the server ever starts, and the healthcheck fails. render.yaml uses the same sh -c form.
